verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect support: a 'Try in playground' entry point for testing the OCR model, and a self-hostable single-container deployment that keeps document data in your own environment, which could serve as an isolated test setup. Neither is documented as a sandbox or test environment separate from production. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or test API keys, isolation of test workloads from production data, mock/sample data guidance, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a sandbox workflow.
